playbookOutputs: Completed & Submitted SARS Form TT01 (Turnover Tax Registration)
SARS Turnover Tax Registration Notice & TT02/TT03 Compliance Calendar
playbookCommonFailures: Company financial year-end is not February (Sixth Schedule disqualifies companies with a non-February year-end unless changed at CIPC first)
Shareholder holds directorship/shares in another registered company (multiple shareholding disqualification under Paragraph 3 of the Sixth Schedule)
Existing business applies after the start of the tax year (1 March) instead of before 1 March (new businesses must apply within 2 months of commencing business)

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copy (< 3 Months) of Sole Proprietor or All Company Directors/Shareholders
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified SA ID copies (< 3 months) of the business owner or all directors/shareholders.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC/SARS KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS. Foreign nationals may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3) — Required If Registering a Company
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: Is the applicant a registered Company / Close Corporation (rather than a Sole Proprietor)?
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 certificate if registering a company (Note: the company financial year-end must end on the last day of February to qualify under the Sixth Schedule).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 showing the registered enterprise name, enterprise number, financial year-end, and directors.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Business Address (< 3 Months) & Business Bank Confirmation Letter (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your proof of business address (< 3 months) and official bank confirmation letter (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of business address and official bank confirmation letter dated within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Sixth Schedule Eligibility Questionnaire — Date Business Commenced, Estimated 12-Month Turnover (<= R1m), Nature of Business, Financial Year-End & Confirmation Shareholders Hold No Other Company Shares
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide: (1) Exact date business started trading, (2) Estimated annual turnover for 1 March – 28 Feb (must be <= R1,000,000), (3) Detailed nature of business (confirming not professional/personal services), (4) Financial year-end (must be February), and (5) Confirmation that no shareholder holds shares in any other company.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect KYC documents, CoR 14.3, bank confirmation, and Sixth Schedule eligibility questionnaire
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified IDs, CoR 14.3 (if company), bank confirmation, proof of address, and Sixth Schedule questionnaire received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Verify all Sixth Schedule qualifying criteria: turnover <= R1,000,000, February financial year-end, no professional service disqualification, and no multiple company shareholdings.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Audit Sixth Schedule Micro Business eligibility and CIPC directorship/shareholding records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Applicant passes all Paragraph 2 & 3 Sixth Schedule Turnover Tax tests
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check that the company financial year-end on CoR 14.3 is February and that directors/shareholders do not hold disqualifying interests in other active companies.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare SARS Form TT01 and Special Power of Attorney for client signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Form TT01 and POA drafted for review and client signature
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Populate Form TT01 with the verified taxpayer details, commencement date, turnover estimate, and Sixth Schedule declarations.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Obtain signed Form TT01 and SARS Power of Attorney from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed Form TT01 and signed POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Send Form TT01 and the POA to the client for signature.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit Form TT01 Turnover Tax registration to SARS via eFiling / SOQS
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: TT01 application submitted to SARS with supporting documents and case number recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Lodge the signed TT01 and supporting pack via SARS eFiling / SOQS and record the SARS case number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for SARS to issue the Turnover Tax Registration Notice
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: SARS issues the Turnover Tax registration confirmation
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Monitor the SARS case status until the Turnover Tax reference is activated.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver Turnover Tax registration confirmation and TT02/TT03 compliance guide
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Turnover Tax registration notice and compliance calendar posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Deliver the registration confirmation and explain the simplified record-keeping rules and TT02 interim payment (August & February) + TT03 annual return deadlines.
